lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.baseline_tension: The finding leans mildly positive against a neutral lean (+0.05), a -6.15% 20-day run-up and falling margin shorts. The run-up weakness looks like 優待 disappointment, not a fundamental read, so the finding cuts slightly against the tape and does not agree with positioning. The price-structure caveat (a 15:00 release inside the 15:30 close) and last year's sold Q1 are why the emitted +0.8 is below the +1.0 finding.

findings.finding: The FY2026/5 決算短信 shows the order backlog at 2026-05-31 up 23.0% YoY: total 7,979百万円 against 6,488, disclosure segment 7,969 against 6,470 (+1,499), and 金商法関連 (有報 etc.) 4,706 against 3,465 (+35.8%). Orders ran +10.7%, yet Q4 (Mar-May) sales grew only +2.2%. The work was booked but not yet billed going into the June 有報 peak, which falls in Q1 (Jun-Aug). A year earlier the backlog fell 2.8% and Q1 still grew sales +8.6%. So Q1 FY27 sales of ~+9-12% and OP of ~+12-22% (progress ~40-42% of 4,900, against 38.7% last year) are the likely outcome. Net of the peer read-through below.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates are from kabutan, and each move runs from the D close (15:30) to the D+1 close off Yahoo daily bars. Q1 FY26 (2025-09-29): sales +8.6% and OP +3.7%, below that year's +8.7% OP guide pace; D -0.24%, then -2.36%. Q1 FY25 (2024-09-30): OP down YoY; -2.58% next session (the Yahoo D-1 bar for that date looks corrupt). Other prints ran -0.70%, +0.32%, +1.56% and +1.20%. The two guide/dividend prints moved +3.35% and +8.03% (the latter after +18% in the final 30 minutes of D). Quarterly beats have not been bought much; the FY guide line moves this stock.

outside_window.finding: September 2026 月次 lands in the first days of October, as August's did on 09-02. Neither is visible in this window unless the company revises alongside Q1, which it has not done in at least four years.
